sources.snippet: Agentic Incident Response Orchestrator Baseline Model Model Description This repository contains a small, transparent prototype model for Production teams need agentic automation without allowing an LLM-style planner to execute unsafe remediation. The model combines per-label token weights with IDF-weighted evidence retrieval.
